parsed.post: New best: 0.861233! Increasing DEPTH=6 and reducing LR to 0.05 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 worked better than my previous attempt. It seems a lower LR combined with warmup is more stable for the higher capacity model. Next: testing a smaller TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE of 262144 to increase optimizer steps for this DEPTH=6 config.
parsed.description: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase gradient updates per 5-minute budget while maintaining the successful DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 configuration.
